<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_with_lid">

  <!-- Base link (the chest body) -->
  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.19" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.4448" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="2.5220" iyz="0.0"
               izz="2.4857"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.19" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.17 0.35 0.38"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="brown">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.19" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.17 0.35 0.38"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Lid link -->
  <link name="lid">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0512" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="0.5705" iyz="0.0"
               izz="0.6214"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.17 0.35 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="light_brown">
        <color rgba="0.71 0.45 0.20 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.01" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.17 0.35 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Revolute joint for the lid -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Hinge is at the back edge of the chest, at the top -->
    <origin xyz="0 0.175 0.38" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit effort="10.0" velocity="1.0" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
